The largest planet in our solar system is **Jupiter**.

Jupiter is a gas giant, the largest of all planets in the solar system, and is entirely composed of gas and liquified elements related mostly to gaseous hydrogen and helium. It is the fifth planet from the Sun, orbiting at a distance of approximately 5 AU (astronomical units) or 778 million km from the Sun.
